title: Humphreys Concerts by the Bay

services.name: Package
services.desc: The menu changes frequently and includes seasonal specialties such as Grilled Canadian Salmon with Pecarino Romano Risotto and Port Wine Sauce, Cedar River Filet Mignon with gorgonzola-potato gratin and tempranillo demi-glace, Seared Alaskan Halibut with Herbed Basmati Rice and Basil Butter Sauce. Dinner Packages also include a choice of dessert made in house by our Pastry Chef. Prices include tax and vary for each show. Please note that each package is built for 2 people and cannot be modified to accommodate additional or less people. Please note that the hotel vouchers are good for the night of the concert only. Hotel Rooms and Suites in these packages do not overlook the concert venue.
